primary.title: Not reporting bank interest or LTCG in your ITR? Avoid these 2 common tax filing mistakes
primary.summary: Many taxpayers mistakenly assume that TDS-deducted income or tax-exempt LTCG need not be disclosed in their ITR. Such omissions can create mismatches with AIS and Form 26AS, leading to tax notices or adjustments even when no additional tax is payable.
